name: ministral-3-14b-bf16
about: Mistral AI Ministral 3 14B Instruct (2512) in BF16, as published by Mistral: the same model as ministral-3-14b without FP8, for the A100, which has no FP8 hardware and on whose generation (an A40) the FP8 version failed to compile. Apache-2.0. Same settings as the FP8 profile: vLLM v0.29.0 (v0.30.0 cannot load Mistral 3, vllm-project/vllm#58755), Mistral's own format, reasoning_effort none, temperature 0.05.
